name: OpsTracker — Alert: CI/CD Pipeline Test Failure
description: Fires when GitHub Actions reports a test execution failure (Playwright or Jest) preventing EC2 deployment.
query: SELECT count(*) AS failure_count FROM cicd_logs WHERE event_type = 'test_execution' AND status = 'failure'

name: OpsTracker — Alert: High HTTP 5xx Error Rate
description: Fires when Fastify backend returns 3 or more 5xx HTTP responses within 5 minutes.
query: SELECT count(*) AS error_count FROM opstracker_logs WHERE statusCode >= 500

name: OpsTracker — Alert: EC2 High CPU Utilization
description: Fires when AWS EC2 instance CPU utilization exceeds 85% sustained over 5 minutes.
query: SELECT avg(cpu_usage_percent) AS avg_cpu FROM ec2_metrics

name: OpsTracker — Alert: EC2 High Memory Usage
description: Fires when AWS EC2 instance RAM usage exceeds 85% sustained over 5 minutes.
query: SELECT avg(memory_usage_percent) AS avg_mem FROM ec2_metrics
